interpretation_boundary: Raw discrepancies are observations only and do not establish scientific equivalence or interchangeability.
Scientific state/storage admissibility tolerances were intentionally not chosen from these observed discrepancies.
Top and bottom fluxes are prescribed in E0 and therefore cannot establish predicted-flux equivalence.
Linear-solve counts are algorithm-specific work diagnostics and are not a performance comparison.

layer_b_operational_application_substitu.interpretation: The current production RossFast route is qualified with its model temporal certificate. The Reference route does not automatically share that same temporal acceptance contract. A full application-level comparison would therefore change both solver and temporal execution policy and must be treated as a separate operational substitution experiment rather than as a pure solver-only treatment.
layer_b_operational_application_substitu.next_requirement: Define and preregister the operational treatment, including which timestep/acceptance-policy differences are part of solver substitution, before comparing full accepted trajectories.

next_permitted_action: Predeclare scientifically defensible state and storage tolerances independently of the observed pilot discrepancy, then freeze a Stage-1 Layer-A E0 sampling design across the six admitted materials. Keep Layer-B operational substitution separate until its treatment definition is explicit.
explicit_nonclaims: RossFast is scientifically equivalent to Reference
RossFast predicts boundary fluxes equivalently in E0
RossFast is faster because it uses a particular number of internal or linear solves
the Layer-B production route failure is a scientific solver failure
